$comment: Parameter register: the single source of truth for what Centerline monitors (ADR-0007).
Parameters keep their URS IDs (P01-P11). A parameter has one or more zones; each zone is a
setpoint/actual tag pair with its own events. Only parameters with status 'active' are monitored.
Tag names are relative to 'namespace'; the full Timebase tag is namespace + '.' + tag.
The MQTT topic/field for each tag is discovered by tools/mqtt-probe and written to its topic map.
Status 'awaiting_tag': the parameter is in the URS but the machine doesn't publish its tags yet.
Status 'analytics_only': an actual tag exists but no setpoint, so it can be X or Y in Analytics but isn't monitored.

parameters.name: Pressure
parameters.tag_review: O-19: the tags look swapped at the source. 'Pressure_Setpoint' behaves like a sensor (about 21,000 changes a day, 213 values, 0 when stopped); 'Pressure_Actual' like an operator setting (about 35 changes a day, clean one-decimal values). With the two swapped and a 1-decimal comparison, P09 gives about 9 events a day at a 30 s delay, like the other parameters. Confirm on the HMI screen before changing this mapping.
parameters.hmi_match_review: O-17: whole numbers are too coarse for a bar-scale value (1.2 and 1.3 bar both truncate to 1). Proposed: compare to 1 decimal. Needs the owner's decision (deviates from HMI-01).

parameters.note: SPC.Feed appeared in Timebase on 2026-09-29 02:26 UTC. It is a single tag (3000, unchanged since): it looks like a setpoint. An actual tag is needed before P10 can be monitored.
